lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4 distinct, low-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular and wide, primarily distributed across the mid-section and posterior half of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and third vertical stripes from the anterior are abbreviated, terminating in the mid-torso region without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 4-5 white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and the proximal portion of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A subset of spots on the upper hind limb exhibits a semi-linear horizontal alignment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, spiraling outward and then inward-upward relative to the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal tip-to-tip pixel distance is approximately 1.2 to 1.5 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white dorsal crest fringe; distinct white spots on the muzzle and sub-orbital region; prominent white patch on the lower throat/chest area; white bands on the upper interior of the limbs.
